description: One anonymous relay payload as prepareRelay carries it in proofInputs, wincode with u8 enum tags, u8 vector lengths and u16 byte lengths. The sender is the shielded keypair of Ed25519 seed 0x05 repeated, the ring 0x06 repeated. It spends one SOL ring UTXO of 900 lamports, blinding 0x0b, tree 4, leaf 17, beside a dummy of blinding 0x1b, and pays 800 back as change of blinding 0x0c with a 100 lamport SOL withdrawal to 0x0e repeated. Pinned by the sdk-libs/client rpc tests. Decode derives each input hash and nullifier again from its opening.
